## About
Arkar Yan is a software architect, developer, and tech instructor based in Yangon. He specializes in building everything from scalable web platforms, custom developer tools, and mobile apps to driving successful business ventures and supply chains. He believes in writing purposeful code, designing thoughtful workflows, and building products that make a genuine impact.
